id: title:bernatixer:remove the summarization model env lever

review.posthog_relevance: Removes the ability to configure the batch trace summarization model via the `LLMA_SUMMARIZATION_MODEL` environment variable, replacing it with a hardcoded OpenAI model. This could reduce fleet-wide configuration flexibility for PostHog users.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H1 removes the environment variable dependency and its associated comments, replacing it with a hardcoded model. This represents a narrowing of configuration options rather than a broad systemic improvement. The tier is assigned based on this localized configuration change, not on unverified benefits or broader systemic impact.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and testing of the new behavior are not shown; the score relies solely on the removal of the configuration option. No evidence of actual benefit or incident avoidance is present.

observations.limitations: This chunk removes configuration and comments, but does not show the complete implementation of the new behavior. P1.F2.H2 removes the use of `settings.LLMA_SUMMARIZATION_MODEL` and replaces it with a hardcoded `OpenAIModel.GPT_5_NANO`. While the comments explain the reasoning, the actual code change removes the dependency on the environment variable and the parsing of it. P1.F1.H1

observations.behavior: Removes the removal of the batch trace summarization model configuration and its associated comments.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes the ability to configure the batch trace summarization model via environment variable, potentially removing a fleet-wide configuration option.
